invitation.title: Defence Family Support Survey
paragraphs: Lutheran Care would like your help to plan its Defence Family Support Program in Greater Darwin.
You can share a family experience, something that has worked well, or an idea for the coming months.
Please answer about your own experience.
invitation.funding: Lutheran Care received funding from Defence Member and Family Support, a branch of the Commonwealth Department of Defence, to deliver this project.

notice: Taking part is voluntary. Most questions are optional.

We do not ask for your name or contact details. Please leave out anything that could identify you or someone else, such as names, addresses or service numbers. The separate contact form does not receive your survey answers.

Lutheran Care will use your answers to plan its NT Defence Family Support Program. We will store them securely and limit access to authorised staff working on this project. Our Privacy Policy explains how we keep and manage records.

We will share project information with Defence after removing details that could reasonably identify anyone. We may need to disclose information to meet legal duties or protect someone from serious harm.
You can stop before submitting. We do not collect a name or contact details for retrieving individual responses afterwards.
Contact feedback@lutherancare.org.au. Our Privacy Policy explains your rights, including access, correction and complaints.
This survey is not a request for services. In an emergency in Australia, call 000. For domestic, family or sexual violence support, contact 1800RESPECT on 1800 737 732.

nt.title: A little about you

fields.label: Which describes you?

options.label: I am a current or former Australian Defence Force (ADF) member
I am a partner, spouse or former partner of an ADF member
I am the child of a current or former ADF member
I am the parent of a current or former ADF member
I am another family member or carer of a current or former ADF member

fields.hint: Select all that apply.

fields.label: Which area do you live in?
fields.hint: Optional. This helps us plan where and how to offer support.

fields.label: Which suburb or locality?

options.label: Another suburb or locality in this area

fields.hint: Optional. You can leave this blank.
fields.options_rule: Show only localities matching the selected residence area, plus other/prefer. Blank retains area only.

fields.label: Which other suburb or locality?
Have you lived in Greater Darwin before?
Which age group are you in?
fields.hint: Optional.

nt.note: ADF relationship, optional local area and adult age band precede the account route.

nt.title: Your life in Greater Darwin

fields.label: How long have you lived in Greater Darwin?

options.label: I have not lived in Greater Darwin

fields.hint: Count your current or most recent stay only.

nt.note: Optional local background. The broader area is chosen first; suburb or locality is optional.

nt.title: What would you like to tell us about?
nt.intro: Choose an experience, something coming up, or an idea. You can add another after each one, or continue without adding anything.
nt.note: Choose an experience or something coming up. A respondent can also continue without adding an account. The add controls are buttons, not a required answer.

nt.title: Experience 1
nt.intro: Think of one situation that mattered to you or your family while living in Greater Darwin in the past 12 months. It may have gone well, been difficult, or still be happening.

fields.label: Tell us about one situation that mattered to you or your family. What was happening?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: Thinking about the situation you described, which best describes the help received?

options.label: Some useful help, but not enough
No useful help, despite trying to get it
No useful help; help was needed but not sought

fields.hint: Answer from what you know. Help may come from family, friends, community or services.

fields.label: What helped, if anything?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: What was difficult, missing or unhelpful, if anything?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: What kind of change would you like to describe?

options.label: Information or help finding a service
Meeting or doing something with others
Changing an existing service or process

fields.hint: Optional. This choice changes the wording of the next question.

fields.label: What would you need to find out or get help doing?
fields.hint: Optional. You do not need to know which organisation could do it. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: What would make the help or activity you described workable for you or your family?
fields.hint: Optional. You can mention timing, a general area, children, access, language, privacy or anything else that matters. Do not include an exact address. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: Default: one optional story, one optional help-status choice, and one distinct optional keep/change box. Helped/difficult boxes appear only after an explicit request for more detail. The proposal helper relabels the existing change box.

fields.label: What would you like to be easier or possible for you or your family in the coming months?

fields.label: What kind of change would you like to describe?

options.label: Information or help finding a service

fields.label: Who would it be for, and what would people do together?
fields.hint: Optional. You can leave this blank if you have already described the change above. You do not need to know which organisation could do it. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: What would make the help or activity you described workable for you or your family?
fields.hint: Optional. You can mention timing, a general area, children, access, language, privacy or anything else that matters. Do not include an exact address. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: Future ideas do not inherit past-help questions. Practical details appear only after an explicit eligible proposal type, a described change and the respondent’s own opt-in.

nt.intro: Think about the coming months. You can share an idea even if nothing has been difficult recently.

fields.label: What would you like to be easier or possible for you or your family in the coming months?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: What kind of change would you like to describe?

options.label: Information or help finding a service

Changing an existing service or process

fields.hint: Optional. This choice changes the wording of the next question.

fields.label: Tell us what you have in mind.
fields.hint: Optional. You can leave this blank if you have already described the change above. You do not need to know which organisation could do it. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

fields.label: If part of your idea is help or an activity you might use, what would make that part workable? You can say which part you mean.
fields.hint: Optional. You can mention timing, a general area, children, access, language, privacy or anything else that matters. Do not include an exact address. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: Several connected ideas stay one account. After explicit opt-in, the practical question asks which personally usable part the respondent means. A process-only idea does not receive this question.

nt.title: Your experiences and ideas
nt.intro: You can add another experience or idea, edit what you have written, or continue.
nt.note: After an account, the respondent may add another experience or idea, edit or remove an existing account, or continue. Up to 100 active accounts can be added; this is a technical ceiling, not a target.

nt.title: Before you finish

fields.label: Of the ideas or changes you mentioned, which would make the biggest difference to you or your family, and why?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: A single optional priority explanation appears only after two or more described changes. With one account, this page is skipped.

nt.title: Before you finish

fields.label: Is there anything else you would like us to understand about family life here?
fields.hint: Optional. Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: This optional final opening appears only when no account was added.

nt.title: Your experience in Greater Darwin
nt.intro: You can share what you learnt from living in Greater Darwin. These experiences will be considered separately from current local needs.

fields.label: What worked well when you lived in Greater Darwin, and what could have been better?
fields.hint: Please leave out names or other details that could identify someone.

nt.note: Separate historical route for people now outside Greater Darwin who have past local experience; not part of the current account sequence.
